purpose: Make a result depend on a condition.
keywords: give explain a reason cause result
Verb conditional ～ば; い-adjective ～ければ; noun / な-adjective + なら（ば）.
If I have time, I will help.
If it is inexpensive, I would like to buy it.
If you press this button, the screen changes.
Choose a conditional that fits the situation
formation: Verb conditional ～ば; い-adjective ～ければ; noun / な-adjective + なら（ば）.
restrictions: Volitional requests can be restricted when the condition is a controllable action by the same person.
mistake: Choose the conditional that fits the situation rather than freely swapping all forms.
